SYMPTOM: Only 1 of 7 items got their imageSearchUUID persisted to DB — 6 were silently lost
CAUSE: Race condition in `setImageSearchUUID` — each of 7 parallel Playwright uploads triggered a separate read-modify-write on the same Search record's items JSON. Concurrent reads all saw the same original state, then each wrote back overwriting the others. Only the last writer's UUID survived.
FIX: Changed to batch approach — collect all 7 {type, uuid} pairs, then do a single `prisma.search.update()` that rewrites the entire items array with all UUIDs embedded at once. Called in `lib/vinted-image-search.ts` after all parallel uploads complete.
PREVENT: Any time multiple async processes update the same JSON column concurrently, batch them into a single write.
RESULT: 'Persisted 7 UUIDs to DB' log confirmed all 7 persist correctly
